objective: Implement only the reusable deterministic runtime foundation needed by the Stage 2 golden vertical slice, without integrating main.gd or authoring Stage 2 content. Add scripts/runtime/danmaku_pattern_runtime.gd, scripts/runtime/stage_encounter_runtime.gd, and tests/assert_m2_pattern_runtime.gd. DanmakuPatternRuntime must accept the frozen schema_version 1 phase dictionary described in the ticket context, select only normal/hard, validate non-numeric topology difference and warnings, derive/use a phase-local deterministic stream without consuming shared gameplay RNG, and advance exact integer ticks. It must emit stable warning/event/boss-movement/bullet-spec records for rebound_bead, grid_edge, lane_fan, rhythm_pulse, and delayed_seed; commit player-aim only at explicit lock ticks; encode reflection/delay/curve behavior in bullet motion data rather than mutating BulletWorld; reject unsupported/malformed emitters; bound per-tick/per-loop output and expose overflow as a hard error. It must support reset, sequential advance, deterministic seek by reset-and-replay, capture/validate/restore snapshot, and a stable telemetry snapshot. StageEncounterRuntime must accept a generic 18-event stage spec, advance a stage tick, emit due events once, pause at explicit midboss/boss gates, resume only through a matching completion token, preserve encounter role/phase cursor, and support deterministic reset/seek/snapshot/restore. No wall clock, audio position, global randomness or frame delta may affect either class. The behavioral assertion must use in-memory fixtures, exercise both difficulties and all five primitives, prove same seed/input gives identical output and snapshot restore, prove a different seed or topology changes structure, prove direct seek equals sequential state, prove gate pause/resume and event uniqueness, and prove malformed/overflow/warning violations fail closed with a nonzero test exit. Avoid brittle exact projectile-count assertions beyond declared safety caps. Do not launch Godot during implementation; release lead will gate one guarded assertion after independent static review.
acceptance_commands: if(@(Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object ProcessName -Like 'Godot*').Count-ne0){throw 'Godot process exists during runtime implementation'}; Write-Host 'GODOT_PROCESS_COUNT=0'

Report every changed file and static command, tests intentionally not run, Godot launch count zero and residual integration work
Confirm main.gd, BulletWorld, BossStateMachine, M1 contracts/content, replay, UI, audio, tools, readiness and project files were not changed
context: Shared phase schema_version is 1. A phase has id, deterministic_random_stream_id, loop_ticks, warning_ticks.normal/hard, boss_movement[3], timeline[4], and difficulties.normal/hard. Each difficulty has topology_id and emitters. Each emitter has id, primitive, start_tick, interval_ticks, bursts_per_loop, shots_per_burst, anchor, family, color_rgba, radius, lifetime_ticks, speed, warning.lead_ticks and primitive-specific angle/routing/motion fields.
The five permitted primitives are rebound_bead, grid_edge, lane_fan, rhythm_pulse and delayed_seed. The runtime may share low-level emit math but must preserve emitter IDs and topology in telemetry.
Output bullet specs must use position Vector2, velocity Vector2, radius, color, family_id, lifetime and motion keys so main integration can call the existing _spawn_enemy_bullet_spec seam later.
Use exact integer 60 Hz ticks. Player position may be supplied as deterministic input to advance/seek; do not read scene globals.
Do not run Godot or any import-producing command in this implementation Agent. Do not commit, merge, spawn subagents, or edit the frozen plan.
